title: 60-Second Molten Lava Chocolate Cake
hookLine: Crisp dark chocolate cake exterior that erupts with warm liquid ganache on the first forkful.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {dark_lv} and {eggs_lv} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Whisk Glossy Lava Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {dark_lv} until glossy. Whisk {eggs_lv} and {sugar_lv} pale, then fold in chocolate and {flour_lv}. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.

steps.title: Bake 11 Mins & Flip Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 11 minutes until sides are firm and centers still soft. Rest 1 minute, invert onto plates, and break open!
steps.criticalTip: Set a strict 11-minute timer—1 extra minute turns the molten core into regular cake!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer 60-Second Molten Lava Chocolate Cake to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 2 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 17 mins.
